**Build passes now.** The bump broke two call sites.

| File | Break | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as off |

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations, not errors. Worth a pass at some point: `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `crypto.createCipher`.
